<a id="music_note_freqs"></a>
### [`music_note_freqs`](../../../../src/music/music_workspace_0cdb.asm#L42) `$0D14-$0D20`

*data*

Frequency low bytes of octave 0 (high byte 1): C $010c to B $01fa. These are the NTSC values of the Programmer's Reference Guide. Entry 0 is the rest.

- **Read by:** [`music_cmd_pattern`](music_driver.md#music_cmd_pattern)

<a id="music_durations"></a>
### [`music_durations`](../../../../src/music/music_workspace_0cdb.asm#L46) `$0D21-$0D30`

*data*

Note duration in ticks minus 1 per index. Index 0-8 give 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36, 48, 72 ticks. Index 9-15 are irregular; 14 is the no-release code.

- **Read by:** [`music_cmd_pattern`](music_driver.md#music_cmd_pattern)
